title: Baba Ganoush
description: A smoky, silky eggplant dip with tahini, lemon and garlic, made by charring the eggplant until it collapses.
equipment: Rimmed baking sheet or gas burner

image.alt: Smoky baba ganoush with olive oil and parsley, with pita

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 450F oven}. Prick the eggplants all over with a fork and roast on the sheet, turning once, until blackened and completely collapsed, {time 35-40 min}. For smokier flavor, char them directly over a gas flame first.
When cool enough to handle, split the eggplants and scoop the flesh into the colander. Let it drain for {time 10 min}, then chop it finely.
Stir the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt and cumin into the eggplant until creamy. Taste and adjust the lemon and salt.
Spread in a shallow bowl, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with parsley.

notes: Draining the eggplant keeps the dip thick instead of watery.
Keeps 4 days in the fridge; it tastes even better on day two.
